description:
Write content to file /sandbox/Redis_CRUD_笔记.md using edit_file. 

Step 1: First use read_file to read the current end of the file.
Step 2: Use edit_file with old_string="### 3.6..." and new_string containing the FULL remaining content for sections 3.6, 3.7, 4, 5, 6, and 7 of the Redis CRUD technical notes.

The content to append should include:
- Section 3.6: KEYS/SCAN with warning about KEYS blocking Redis
- Section 3.7: EXISTS/TYPE/TTL/EXPIRE commands
- Section 4: UPDATE commands (INCR, INCRBY, DECR, APPEND, LSET, LTRIM)
- Section 5: DELETE commands (DEL, UNLINK, HDEL, LREM, SREM, ZREM, FLUSHDB/FLUSHALL with async option, EXPIRE for auto-delete)
- Section 6: Python redis-py examples (install, connect via ConnectionPool, String/Hash/List/Set/Sorted Set CRUD with hset/hget/hgetall, lpush/rpush/lrange, sadd/smembers, zadd/zrange)
- Section 7: Best practices (at least 8 items: naming conventions, TTL, SCAN not KEYS, pipeline, connection pool, avoid FLUSHALL in prod, Lua for distributed locks, monitor big keys, O(N) commands awareness, backup)

Keep the new_string short enough to not get truncated - under 8000 characters. Use proper markdown formatting with backtick code blocks.
